Gemini Omni Flash is a high-performance model for fast, conversational video
generation and editing.

## gemini-omni-1.1-flash

| Property | Description |
|---|---|
| Model code | **Gemini API** `gemini-omni-1.1-flash` |
| Supported data types | **Input** Text, Image, Video (up to 10s for editing and extension) **Output** Video |
| Limits | **Context window** 1,048,576 tokens **Output video** 3s-10s (360p/720p/1080p/4K, 24 FPS) |
